# Android Dependency Migration Plan Template

Fill from the audit report. One section per PR. Mark adapter PRs clearly.

```markdown
# Dependency migration plan — YYYY-MM-DD

**Project:** <project name>
**Based on audit:** `workflow/deps/YYYY-MM-DD.md` (or inline session)
**Scope:** all stale/yanked | named artifacts: ___
**Generated by:** skill `android-deps-migration-plan`

---

## PR order (execute top-to-bottom)

| # | Title | Track | Risk | Depends on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Create version catalog (if absent) | setup | low | -- |
| 1 | | A/B/C-adapter/C-bump | low/medium/high | -- |
| 2 | | | | PR N |
| ... | | | | |
| LAST | Bump AGP + Gradle wrapper | B | high | all others |

---

## PR-0 (if needed) -- Create version catalog

- **Why:** no `gradle/libs.versions.toml` found; required before version pin management
- **Files:** `gradle/libs.versions.toml` (new), `app/build.gradle.kts` (migrate deps)
- **Done when:** `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` passes with catalog as sole pin source

---

## PR-N -- <Title>

**Track:** A (version-only) | B (coupled) | C-adapter (code change) | C-bump (version after adapter)
**Risk:** low | medium | high
**Depends on:** PR-X (if any)

### Changes

| File | What to change |
| --- | --- |
| `gradle/libs.versions.toml` | `<alias> = "<old>" -> "<new>"` |

### Breaking changes
_Source: <official changelog URL>_
- <breaking change 1>
- <none> if patch/minor with no breaking changes

### Verification
```text
./gradlew :app:ktlint :app:testDebugUnitTest
```

### Done when
<observable criterion, e.g. "build passes, no test failures, no new lint warnings">

---

## Out of scope

- <library family> -- user did not request this substitution
- AGP / Gradle wrapper -- separate dedicated task
- <anything else explicitly excluded>

## Risk summary

| PR | Risk | Blast radius (files) | Reversible |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | low/medium/high | N files | yes/no |
```
